entries.title: Show HN: I wrote a book about WebAssembly
entries.author: raboukhalil
entries.current_title: Show HN: I wrote a book about WebAssembly
entries.excerpt: Hey HN! I've been working on a book about WebAssembly over the last few months, and it's finally available at http://levelupwasm.com ! Why a book on WebAssembly you ask? Well... WebAssembly is awesome (obviously ) but it's certainly not the easiest thing to learn. So I wrote this book as a practical intro to using WebAssembly in your web apps. I would appreciate any feedback!
entries.guide_zh: 作者介绍自己写的 WebAssembly 实践书，希望降低学习门槛。

entries.title: Show HN: Learn C and its lower levels interactively, in the browser
entries.author: vasyop
entries.current_title: Show HN: Learn C and its lower levels interactively, in the browser
entries.excerpt: I made a simple virtual machine that runs C in the browser.This project is made as an experiment to see if C can be learned easier if the lower level is covered in paralel. Sandbox: https://vasyop.github.io/miniC-hosting Tutorial part 1: https://vasyop.github.io/miniC-hosting/?0 More info: https://github.com/vasyop/miniC-hosting/blob/master/README.md Please support this project: https://github.com/vasyop/miniC-hosting/blob/master/support.md
entries.guide_zh: 在浏览器里运行 C 虚拟机，把语言学习与底层机制一起展示。
